verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Terminal ships official SDKs for iOS and Android, plus React Native, for building a custom POS integration. The SDK supports Tap to Pay contactless acceptance on compatible iPhones and Android devices, and includes a simulated reader for testing. A versioned migration guide (v5.0.0) shows the SDK is maintained. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the iOS/Android SDKs specifically, since the only GitHub repo cited is the JS SDK and the community comment covers API-level integration in general.
